dedupe_keys.name: electric vehicle managed charging cost supply curves 2025 2050

description: The managed-charging research team publishes cost supply curves for electric-vehicle charging programs through 2050. The Zenodo release contains CSV tables of per-vehicle costs at one-percentage-point participation steps, scenario variables and fitted coefficients. The article relates costs to enrollment incentives, dispatch mechanism, vehicle type and year. Coverage is scenario years 2025 to 2050 across program and vehicle types. Public access is free under CC BY 4.0. The curves can inform demand-flexibility and capacity-planning studies, after mapping enrolled vehicles to kilowatts in a grid model such as model-pypsa. A caveat is that per-vehicle program cost is not automatically a power-capacity cost or a universal local tariff. Customer response and flexibility assumptions govern the feasible curve; the source describes scenarios, not observed future participation. Own metadata and filenames were checked without reading CSV rows or recalculating estimates. The separate GitHub generator and query code remains a distinct software lead.
